text: Implemented on work/claude-w01 (95fa2633): GoldenRoute's Pending.LibraryScores stub is replaced by a 'direct-library scores' step that admits and runs the reopened r3/rev4 through eyes4s (RealAdmission, RealPrepared) and requires SCORES.json M/B/D for every contributing query at 4 scales (tolerance 5e-7+1e-12), 457 = 454 + 3, groups 2..17. GoldenJourneySuite now records only the 'import dialog' stub. Tolerance-0 mutant fails. Route remains fake-backed; real twin = NativeCommandJourneySuite + NativeGoldenCommandFxSuite (SCORES-held).
